show.fullName: Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! The Musical
show.tagline: A hilarious new musical comedy created by Abbie Freeston and Matthew Stanley, taking you on the rollercoaster that is love, life, and being a constant disappointment to your parents.
show.aboutCompany: FWAMP Theatre Company is an innovative and unique theatre company, specialising in musical theatre comedy. Our team met while working on musical theatre projects as students at the University of Leeds, and now want to continue our passion in our professional work. The idea for Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! came together from a conversation around how the world can be a bit bleak at times, and how important it is to create entertainment for entertainment's sake. Our show is silly, heartwarming and relatable for both British and global audiences - with storylines and songs for everyone.
show.aboutShow: Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! follows Theme Park nepo baby Teddy Mega as he struggles with inheriting his family's legacy, navigating relationships and keeping a big secret from his mum. As he takes on the role of CEO, Teddy reveals his one true passion is to become the theme park's infamous mascot instead. FWAMP is hilariously shameless, with genres spanning RnB, disco and contemporary musical theatre, relatable and outlandish characters that showcase the rollercoaster that is love, life, and being a constant disappointment to your parents.

team.name: Abbie Freeston
team.bio: Abbie is one of the FWAMP! creators, the director, choreographer, and founder of FWAMP! Theatre Company. She studied Theatre at University of Leeds and has since worked on a multitude of productions and events as a writer, director and performer. Credits include: FWAMP! (Leeds), Swan Song the Musical (Penge, London), Flashdance, A Chorus Line, Legally Blonde and Grease (Leeds). She is so excited to showcase the joy and craziness of FWAMP! to the world this summer.

team.name: Matthew Stanley
team.bio: Matthew is a professional guitarist and Musical Director with recent touring credits including Guitar 1 on the UK premiere tour of 'The Rock and Roll Man' and Guitar 2 on 'The Percy Jackson Musical' UK Tour. Matthew was also recently the Orchestrator and Associate Musical Director for the critically acclaimed off West End run of 'Swan Song' (written by Zara Harris).

team.name: Savannah Perry
team.bio: Savannah is a theatre producer and publicist from Cardiff and loves all things musical theatre. She has worked on a range of theatre productions, with previous credits including Swan Song: The Musical (London), Legally Blonde, Grease, Footloose (Leeds) and producing FWAMP!'s 2025 run. She is thrilled to be working on bringing the hilarious and wonderful world of Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! to life at the Edinburgh Fringe.

team.name: Zara Harris
team.bio: Zara Harris is a composer, musical director and pianist. Recent work as an MD includes NewsRevue (Canal Cafe Theatre), Beauty and the Beast (The Bridge House Theatre) and Lost the Plot (the improvised musical). Zara wrote and composed the musical Swan Song which had successful runs in both Leeds and London. She is thrilled to be back with FWAMP! and is excited to see this new iteration of the show unfold!

team.name: Mimi Roberts
team.bio: Mimi is a trained pianist and vocalist who's been involved in music and musical theatre for as long as she can remember. She recently graduated from the University of Leeds, although she has most recently MD-ed productions of Pippin (Cygnet Players), Flashdance and A Chorus Line (Leeds University Union) and is very excited to get away from the excel spreadsheets of her day job and instead enter the weird and wonderful world of FWAMP!

team.name: Ella Fairley
team.bio: Ella is a recent graduate from the University of Leeds, where she studied Music. She is a classically trained singer with years of performance and teaching experience. Her recent performance and production team credits include: Grease, Legally Blonde: The Musical, A Chorus Line, Flashdance, Dogfight and High School Musical with Leeds University Union. She's super excited to join the FWAMP! team for the Fringe, and cannot wait to get started!
